en: After a Pour or a Cut
Know what every candle, soap and balm costs and what to charge
Formula costing, batch costs and pricing for candle, soap and body-care makers
Batch cost sheet with the gap to standard
every batch shows its cost per good unit against the standard cost of the product, so a batch that used too much wax or too many hours is flagged the same day
Full cost per unit with overhead and packaging
materials, labour minutes, the overhead per unit and the packaging add up to the cost that a price has to cover, for all 24 products
Margin after channel fee and shipping
each product and channel shows the fee, the shipping you absorb and the margin left, with the lowest price that keeps your minimum margin
Fragrance load check on every batch
wax and fragrance weights give the load (fragrance weight as a share of wax weight), the gap to the target and the fragrance cost of the batch
oil weights, the factors from your own supplier sheet, a discount and a water ratio give the lye and water in grams as plain arithmetic, never a recipe claim
components, box, tissue and assembly minutes give the cost of a set, the price for your margin and the saving the customer sees against buying the parts
a new cost per kilogram becomes a cost per unit, a lower margin and the price rise needed, before you decide to raise a price or to absorb it
the courier cost, the shipping you charge and your margin give the order value where free shipping still pays, next to the amount you use now
a discount shows the margin after it, the profit lost on each sale and the extra units you must sell to earn the same profit
Minimum price and break-even by product
the lowest price with no loss, the lowest price for your minimum margin and the units a month that cover your fixed costs
Price tests with the profit change
units before and during a test at a new price give the unit change and the change in profit, so a price rise that cost more sales than it earned is visible
Shipping bands against the courier cost
each method and weight band compares the price you charge with the courier cost and marks the bands that lose money

Products with cost, margin and the price you need
The 24 products with retail and wholesale price; materials, labour, full cost, margins, the price for your target and the margin in each channel fill in by themselves.
Materials with cost per 100 grams and where they are used
The 34 materials with the cost per kilogram or per piece and the supplier; the cost per 100 grams, the cost of one pack, the formulas that use each and the last price change fill in.
Cost in one batch of each formula
Formula lines at today's material prices
One row for each material or finished component in a batch of a product; the cost, the line cost and the share of the batch cost fill in from the Materials prices.
Batch cost sheets with the gap to the standard cost
One row for each batch (one production run with its own batch number) with its material cost and hours; labour, cost per good unit, the gap to the standard cost of the product and the check fill in.
Price list by channel with margin after fee and shipping
One row for each product and channel with the price and the shipping you absorb; the channel fee, the margin after fee and shipping, the lowest price for the minimum margin and a flag fill in.
Lowest price for the minimum margin
Sales channels with fee and payout days
The five sales channels with the fee each one keeps and the days until you are paid; the price list takes its fee from here.
Fragrance load records with the gap to the target

One row for each candle or wax melt batch with the wax and the fragrance weighed; the load (fragrance weight as a share of wax weight), the gap to the target, the check and the fragrance cost fill in.
Lye and water sheets from the factors you type
One soap batch per row with the oil weight and the factors from your supplier sheet; lye and water fill in as plain arithmetic. Check your own local rules.
Overhead by month and per unit made
One row for each month with rent, utilities, software, insurance, marketing and other costs and the units made; the total and the overhead per unit fill in and feed the full cost of every product.
Packaging kits with the cost of one order
The 12 packaging kits (box or mailer, tissue and label, tape and card) by product group; the cost of packing one order fills in.
Shipping rate bands against the courier cost
The shipping price you charge and the courier cost for each method and weight band; the gap and a flag for bands that lose money fill in.
Discount rules with dates and the limit
The discount codes and offers by channel with minimum order and dates; the status, the days left and a check against the largest discount you give without asking the owner fill in.
One row for each change of a price in a channel with the old and the new price, the reason and who changed it; the change percent and its direction fill in.
One row for each change of a material cost with the old and the new cost and the reason; the supplier, its phone, the change percent and the direction fill in, and the last change feeds Materials.
Comparable products from other sellers against ours
One row for each comparable product seen in a shop or online with its size and price; the price per 100 grams, our price and the gap to it fill in, so you see where you are cheap or dear.
Gift set lines with the value of each component
The parts of each gift set in three builds with their retail price; the value of the parts, their share, the set price, its cost and its margin fill in.
Price tests with the change in units sold
One row for each price test with the old and the test price and the units sold before and during it; the price change, the unit change, the profit change and the status fill in.
Suppliers with contact, lead time and terms
The 12 suppliers with contact, phone, lead days and payment terms; the materials each supplies and its price rises in the last 90 days fill in.
Seasons with the demand factor of each month
The 12 months with the demand factor and the season; the share above or below an average month fills in.

Supplier: send your new price list
Hello {contact}, please send your new price list. We update our costs every month. Thank you.
Supplier: can you match the quote
Hello, can you match another quote for {material}? Our last cost was {new_cost}. Thank you.
Supplier: the rise needs a new quote
Hello, the price of {material} rose from {old_cost} to {new_cost}. Please send us a new quote.
Supplier: a quote for a larger quantity
Hello, please quote a larger quantity of {name}. We pay {unit_cost} now and the pack size is {pack_size}.
Supplier: confirm the pack size and cost
Hello, please confirm the pack size ({pack_size}) and the cost ({unit_cost}) of {name}. Thank you.
Hello {maker}, please use the new formula for {product} from the next batch. The standard unit cost is {standard_cost}.
Maker: the batch cost was above standard
Hello {maker}, batch {batch_no} of {product} cost {cost_per_good} per good unit against {standard_cost}. Please check the weights next time.
Hello {maker}, the fragrance load of {product} was {load_pct} against a target of {target_load}. Please weigh it again.
Maker: weigh the lye and water again
Hello {maker}, before the batch of {product}: lye {lye_g} grams and water {water_g} grams. Please weigh both again.
Hello {maker}, the new batch size for {product} is {planned_units} units. Please plan your next batch on that size.
Packer: the new packaging kit cost
Hello, the cost of the {kit} is now {cost_per_order} per order. Please use the new kit.
Packer: use the gift box from today
Hello, please use the gift box for {name} from today. Its unit cost is {unit_cost}.
Shop assistant: update the shop price
Hello, please update the price of {product} to {price} in this channel: {channel}.
Hello, the new marketplace price of {product} is {price} from {changed_on}. Please update the listing.
Shop assistant: the discount code ends
Hello, the discount rule {rule} ends on {valid_until}. Please remove it from the shop that day.
Hello, the price for the {method} up to {up_to_g} grams is now {price_charged}. Please update the web shop and the free shipping amount.
